lash_sessions.head_json.reason: SessionHeadPayload carries schema_version and is rejected by decode_versioned_json_record before typed decode.

lash_graph_nodes.node_json.reason: StoredSessionNodeBody states SESSION_NODE_BODY_SCHEMA_VERSION and is fenced against newer generations on decode; its shape is guarded by that surface in scripts/versioned-surfaces.toml, which spans the session-history model the schemars payload projection cannot reach.

lash_usage_deltas.entry_json.reason: TokenLedgerEntry identity is pinned by payload_encoding_version and payload_hash columns with a permanent tag registry.

lash_runtime_turn_commits.result_json.reason: RuntimeCommitReceipt is a receipt coupled to turn_commit_hash and identity_encoding_version; enrolling the full receipt DTO is a separate cutover.

lash_queued_work_batches.authority_json.reason: QueuedWorkAuthority belongs to the shared queue protocol and lacks a JsonSchema durability contract; enroll with that protocol as a unit.

lash_queued_work_items.payload_json.reason: QueuedWorkPayload is a shared runtime sum type; enrolling all command and wake variants is a separate queue-schema cutover.

lash_pending_turn_inputs.ingress_json.reason: TurnInputIngress is a shared admission protocol sum type; enroll together with its cross-backend representation.

lash_pending_turn_inputs.input_json.reason: TurnInput includes host-facing content and attachments and has no bounded JsonSchema durability contract yet.

lash_pending_turn_inputs.claim_owner_liv.reason: Reserved compatibility column; current claim writes always bind NULL and projection ignores its value.

lash_processes.record_json.reason: ProcessRecord spans the durable process model; enrolling its nested specs, waits, provenance, and status is a separate process-schema cutover.

lash_process_events.event_json.reason: ProcessEvent spans all durable process event variants and must be enrolled with ProcessRecord as one process-schema cutover.

lash_process_wake_deliveries.delivery_js.reason: WakeDelivery is part of the process wake protocol and must be enrolled with the process carrier family.

lash_process_leases.lease_owner_liveness.reason: Reserved compatibility column; current writes always bind NULL and reads ignore its value.

lash_process_segment_handovers.handover_.reason: ProcessSegmentHandover is part of the process execution protocol and must be enrolled with the process carrier family.

lash_process_parent_end_plans.actions_js.reason: ToolIntentParentEndAction is a compact process-lifecycle plan validated by full replay identity; enroll with the complete ProcessRecord and segment-handover carrier family.

lash_tool_intent_submissions.submission_.reason: ToolIntentSubmissionRecord is component-51 process-protocol state coupled to indexed identity, kind, and payload-hash columns; enroll it with the complete process carrier family.

lash_runtime_effect_replay.envelope_json.reason: The PostgreSQL backend stores and returns the controller-owned opaque JSON string without deserializing a Rust struct.

lash_runtime_effect_replay.outcome_json.reason: The PostgreSQL backend stores and returns the controller-owned opaque terminal JSON string without typed deserialization.

lash_runtime_effect_replay.error_json.reason: The PostgreSQL backend stores and returns the controller-owned opaque terminal JSON string without typed deserialization.

lash_await_event_waits.scope_json.reason: Await scope identity is encoded and compared by the shared await-event coordinator; enroll the whole keyed-promise protocol together.

lash_await_event_waits.wait_json.reason: Await wait identity is encoded and compared by the shared await-event coordinator; enroll the whole keyed-promise protocol together.

lash_await_event_waits.terminal_json.reason: Await terminal values are controller-owned Resolution JSON; enroll them with scope and wait as one keyed-promise protocol.

lash_trigger_subscriptions.record_json.reason: TriggerSubscriptionRecord is coupled to indexed projection columns and belongs to the complete trigger-store schema cutover.

lash_trigger_occurrences.record_json.reason: TriggerOccurrenceRecord is coupled to indexed projection columns and belongs to the complete trigger-store schema cutover.

lash_trigger_deliveries.subscription_sna.reason: The subscription snapshot is a TriggerSubscriptionRecord copy and must move with the trigger carrier family.

lash_trigger_mutation_receipts.result_js.reason: Trigger command results are replay receipts tied to request_fingerprint and must move with the trigger carrier family.
